name: ownchat
description: Self-hosted AI creation platform (Cloudflare Workers + static assets). Zero runtime dependencies by design; this file exists so Cloudflare's one-click deploy can pre-fill the build and deploy commands.

NVIDIA_API_KEY.description: Free-tier model key from [build.nvidia.com](https://build.nvidia.com). Required for chat (free mode).

DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.description: Optional. Enables "fast" mode and conversation summaries (DeepSeek official API).

CHAT_PASSWORD.description: Strongly recommended: access password for /api/* and /sync — without it your model quota is open to anyone with the URL. Also the in-app login.
